description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise of the Australian Bakers Delight chain, baking all products fresh from scratch daily on-site with no freezing or refrigeration. The Kensington Square location offers a full range of breads, pastries, scones, cruffins, and savoury items including pizza. Any unsold baked goods are donated to local charities at day's end, so the selection is always freshly made.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is COBS Bread's corporate site; the specific Kensington Square store locator page failed to render store-level details (phone, address), so OSM tags are the primary source for contact fields. The website confirms COBS Bread as an active, operational Canadian bakery franchise baking daily from scratch and selling bread, pastries, and savoury items including pizza. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field is tagged 'North Vancouver' but the website URL slug is 'kensington-square-burnaby', indicating the location is in Burnaby, not North Vancouver.
The store-specific locator page did not render store-level contact details, so phone number and address could not be verified against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible bakery franchise selling fresh bread and baked goods daily — a practical food stop for touring cyclists.
